g.text: A: ratio of the protein-cluster interval to the site-level interval for the same estimate (estimates from the site-level analysis; compares interval methods only). B:
gene-cluster against accession-cluster interval, D1 contrasts, populations P-all (black) and P-human (purple). C: ratio of the width of the two-way (protein x study) interval
to the width of the protein-cluster interval, primary contrast in P-all. D: out of 1,000 resamples; orange bars mark rows with failed fits.
